name: How long does a typical bathroom sink installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom sink installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom sink installation can vary depending on the sink type, existing plumbing conditions, and whether a new countertop is also being installed. A straightforward replacement of a similar sink, assuming existing plumbing is adequate, can often be completed in 2 to 4 hours. If plumbing modifications are needed, or if it's part of a larger renovation involving countertop replacement, the process will take longer, potentially requiring a full day or more. City Dweller, LLC provides estimated timelines based on project specifics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 2-4 hours for a simple replacement. More complex jobs with plumbing modifications or countertop changes may take a full day or longer.
